entries.signal: The same composition survives unrelated sources.
entries.test: Replace the source and tokens; reject if the shell still claims fit.

entries.signal: Identity depends only on copied colors.
More layers or effects are called more original.
entries.test: Compare a simpler matched alternative and locate the source relation.

entries.signal: Elements are combined without a mechanism or predicted effect.
entries.test: Require a mechanism and falsifier before rendering.

entries.signal: Finish hides overlap, hierarchy, accessibility, state, or evidence failures.
entries.test: Apply objective vetoes before taste review.

entries.signal: Large shapes collide, type hierarchy competes, and modules lack one source-bearing relation.
entries.test: Use evals/files/rejected-editorial-board.svg only as a negative fixture.
